verdicts.reason: A keeps the 3-line centered headline and a readable CTA pill, but the CTA has drifted far below the headline with a big dead gap between them, so the pair no longer reads as one group, and the headline is undersized for the taller canvas. B shrinks the CTA to a tiny pill whose label is barely legible, jams it against the bottom edge and places it visibly left of the centre axis; the headline is also small and sits in a sea of empty orange, which buries the call to action.
